buildCommand: pnpm db:migrate && pnpm build && rm -rf .vercel/output && cp -R apps/web/.vercel/output .vercel/output
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" != "main" ]; then exit 0; fi; git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- . ':(exclude)docs' ':(exclude)*.md' ':(exclude)design' ':(exclude).claude' ':(exclude).agents' ':(exclude).github' ':(exclude)skills-lock.json'
